eng1.spatial_query_1a9b0.semantics: Call 1a9e0 with unchanged query pointer; return its nonzero selector immediately. Otherwise reload EngineInterface.context_004 (cell 0x70f24); return 0 if its first byte is 9, else call 1ab00 with the same pointer and return its result.

eng1.spatial_query_1a9e0.semantics: Require WORD[state_72020+0x2e] != 0 and count WORD[state+0x36] != 0. Snapshot six query WORDs before scanning count 12-byte rows at VA 0x10071ee0 as six signed WORDs. Reject if r3<q0 || r4<q1 || r5<q2 || q3<r0 || q4<r1 || q5<r2 using signed WORDs; touching overlaps. First overlap reloads state pointer, stores index+1 to +0x36, and returns it; no hit returns 0 without the store.
eng1.spatial_query_1a9e0.extent: RET at 0x1aaf3; 12 NOPs through 0x1aaff; next entry 0x1ab00.

eng1.spatial_query_1ab00.semantics: Require WORD[state_72018+0x2e] != 0; call actor_bounds_2a880(actor, local 12-byte bounds, mode 2), then existing bounds_overlap(query, local bounds). Any failed gate/helper returns 0; both helpers succeeding returns 0x20. No direct persistent-state store.
eng1.spatial_query_1ab00.extent: RET at 0x1ab41/0x1ab47; 8 NOPs through 0x1ab4f; next entry 0x1ab50.

eng1.spatial_query_26de0.semantics: Produce query bounds with actor_bounds_2a880(actor, bounds, mode 1); failure returns 0. Call 1a9b0 and propagate nonzero selector unchanged. Otherwise scan the signed-count worklist at 0x71900, testing candidate XYZ with point_in_box_2a810 and returning the first hit pointer; after a miss, if WORD[0x6fec4] is set and bounds at 0x71440 overlap, return 0x80; otherwise return 0.
